input.task:
Repo: Moneo (Next.js 16 + TypeScript, Windows dev machine, GitHub Actions CI). Read AGENTS.md first and follow it (no code comments, surgical changes, commit each step, plain commit messages).

Goal: make `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` as fast as possible without losing any check. Today locally: typecheck ~90 s (it runs `next typegen && tsc --noEmit && node scripts/typecheck-indexed.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p desktop`), lint ~60 s in CI (`eslint .` with custom `moneo/*` rules in eslint.config.mjs, typed rules like no-floating-promises). CI job timings: lint 64 s, typecheck 30 s (plus npm ci).

Ideas to evaluate, measure, keep only what wins and still catches the same errors:
1. TypeScript native compiler (`@typescript/native-preview`, `tsgo`) for the three tsc runs; or run them in parallel; check `incremental`/tsBuildInfo use.
2. ESLint: `--cache` with a content-based cache strategy (and cache the file in CI), typed-lint cost (projectService), maybe oxlint for the rules it covers with eslint keeping only the rules oxlint lacks (custom moneo rules must keep running; oxlint JS plugins may run them). Don't drop a rule.
3. Anything else you find (e.g. what `prelint` / `check:features` / `check:privacy` cost).

Prove each change: time before/after (3 runs), and show that an injected type error and an injected lint violation (e.g. a comment, a floating promise, a moneo/import-boundaries violation) still fail. Update `.github/workflows/ci.yml` if caching helps there. Update AGENTS.md's rules table only if an enforcing tool changes.

Branch from your worktree's base, then open a PR with `gh pr create --base t3/speed-build-and-startup` (NOT main). PR body: before/after numbers table, what you tried that did not help, "Speed" section. End PR body with "🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)" is not needed — just describe it. Never run anything against the owner's backend (.env, port 3000). Your last line: PR <url>, head <sha>, checks <state>.

input.title: Faster desktop cold start
input.task:
Repo: Moneo, an Electron desktop app (desktop/) that on launch starts bundled Postgres, GoTrue, Storage API, PostgREST, a gateway, then a Next.js standalone server, then opens the window. Read AGENTS.md (especially "Desktop app") and desktop/README.md, desktop/src/backend/README.md first, and follow AGENTS.md (no comments, surgical changes, commit each step).

Goal: make the time from double-clicking Moneo (app closed, and after a reboot = cold disk cache) until the Home page is usable as short as possible, and the app lighter (memory, processes). Measure first, then fix, commit by commit.

Measure: `node scripts/desktop/fetch-backend.mjs --platform win-x64` once, `npm run desktop:build`, then run with `MONEO_DESKTOP_HOME` set to a scratch folder (NEVER the owner's real user-data folder or installed app). Add timestamps from the logs (desktop/src/paths.ts log, backend.log) for each phase: electron ready, port, certificate, postgres start, each service ready, migrations check, owner creation, Next server ready (/api/health), window first paint, Home rendered. Do both a first run and a second (normal) start. `npm run desktop:smoke` exists too.

Known candidates in desktop/src/main.ts and desktop/src/backend/index.ts:
- auth (GoTrue), storage and rest (PostgREST) start strictly one after another; they only need Postgres. Start them concurrently; start the Next server as soon as its env is known (ports can be chosen up front) instead of after the whole backend + owner step.
- ensureBankCertificate runs serially before the backend; move it off the critical path if it can.
- createOwner / migrationState / revokeMigrationOwners / ALTER ROLE run every start; skip work already done (config.json knows schemaVersion etc.) while still detecting real changes.
- waitFor polling intervals; Next readiness polls every 250 ms.
- Next server cold start: try Node's compile cache (module.enableCompileCache / NODE_COMPILE_CACHE in a folder under the Moneo home) for the utilityProcess and the storage fork; measure.
- Show the window (or the setup screen) immediately and load Home as soon as Next is ready; check the first page request isn't slowed by on-demand compilation or cold DB caches.
- Postgres settings for a single-user desktop (shared_buffers, fsync is NOT allowed to be turned off — data safety first), GoTrue/Storage memory.
Keep data safety: pre-upgrade backup, migrations and error reporting must still work exactly. Keep security fuses.

Report a before/after table per phase. Open a PR with `gh pr create --base t3/speed-build-and-startup` (NOT main), with the numbers and a Speed section. Run npm test, npm run lint, npm run typecheck before. Last line: PR <url>, head <sha>, checks <state>.

strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { id: win-x64, runner: windows-latest }
          - { id: mac-arm64, runner: macos-15 }
          - { id: mac-x64, runner: macos-15-intel }
          - { id: linux-x64, runner: ubuntu-24.04 }
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        id: modules
        with:
          path: node_modules
          key: modules-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-node22-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json', 'package.json', '.npmrc') }}
      - if: steps.modules.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npm ci
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        id: backend
        with:
          path: |
            desktop/.build/backend/${{ matrix.id }}
            desktop/.build/storage-api
          key: backend-${{ matrix.id }}-node22-${{ hashFiles('scripts/desktop/fetch-backend.mjs', 'scripts/desktop/backend-fs-xattr-shim/**') }}
      - if: steps.backend.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
          if [ "$TAG" != "v$version" ]; then
            echo "::error::Tag $TAG does not match desktop/package.json version $version."
            exit 1
          fi

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22

      - uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        id: modules
        with:
          path: node_modules
          key: modules-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-node22-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json', 'package.json', '.npmrc') }}

      # No setup-go: fetch-backend.mjs downloads its own pinned Go toolchain into desktop/.cache.
      - if: steps.modules.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        run: npm ci

      - uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        id: backend
